title: tragacantha baghensis
intro: Tragacantha baghensis, commonly known as Himalayan milk thistle or Bahiabadra, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Tragacantha baghensis include its hepatoprotective and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help in treating liver and digestive disorders. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective properties.
